# ffxf_account (Data Source)

Reads billing balance, usage, budget, quota, and auto-top-up details for the account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    ffxf = {
      source = "ffxfnet/ffxf"
    }
  }
}

provider "ffxf" {}

data "ffxf_account" "current" {}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `account` (Attributes) Current account billing and quota information. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account))

<a id="nestedatt--account"></a>
### Nested Schema for `account`

Read-Only:

- `auto_topup` (Attributes) Automatic credit top-up configuration. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account--auto_topup))
- `billing_mode` (String) Billing mode, prepaid or postpaid.
- `budget` (Attributes) Monthly account budget and usage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account--budget))
- `credit` (Attributes) Available account credit. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account--credit))
- `currency` (String) Account currency code.
- `hourly` (Attributes) Current hourly usage and runway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account--hourly))
- `quota` (Attributes) Machine quota usage. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--account--quota))

<a id="nestedatt--account--auto_topup"></a>
### Nested Schema for `account.auto_topup`

Read-Only:

- `amount` (String) Amount added by each top-up, or null.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether automatic top-up is enabled.
- `threshold` (String) Credit balance that triggers a top-up, or null.


<a id="nestedatt--account--budget"></a>
### Nested Schema for `account.budget`

Read-Only:

- `cap_percent` (Number) Budget usage percentage at which machines are stopped.
- `month_to_date` (String) Amount spent this month.
- `monthly` (String) Monthly budget, or null when unset.
- `percent` (Number) Percentage of budget consumed.


<a id="nestedatt--account--credit"></a>
### Nested Schema for `account.credit`

Read-Only:

- `balance` (String) Total spendable credit.
- `gifted` (String) Granted credit.
- `gifted_expires_at` (String) Earliest remaining gifted-credit expiry.
- `paid` (String) Purchased credit.


<a id="nestedatt--account--hourly"></a>
### Nested Schema for `account.hourly`

Read-Only:

- `active_machines` (Number) Number of active machines.
- `burn_rate` (String) Sum of current hourly machine rates.
- `runway_hours` (Number) Estimated hours remaining at the current burn rate.


<a id="nestedatt--account--quota"></a>
### Nested Schema for `account.quota`

Read-Only:

- `limit` (Number) Maximum machines.
- `remaining` (Number) Remaining machine quota.
- `used` (Number) Machines currently used.
